agreements.agreement: seed, knowledge graph, GraphRAG, and Palantir all treat knowledge as entities plus relationships rather than isolated text/data.
all expansion sources reinforce that graph/ontology adds relation structure on top of raw tables, chunks, documents, or system data.
the practical loop is data -> relation/context model -> LLM/logic access -> decision/action.
supports VectorTube as mini-space builder: vector/text retrieval alone is insufficient without relation/layer extraction.

tensions.tension: seed frames urgency through national/industrial sovereignty; IBM videos frame education/governance; Palantir frames productized operational control.
enterprise vendor videos may convert ontology from open conceptual structure into platform dependency; this must not become VectorFL authority.
GraphRAG/Palantir materials emphasize benefits but understate graph construction cost, schema governance, vendor bias, and domain validation.
seed is Korean sovereign/industrial context; expansions are mostly English enterprise/vendor context, so direct transfer may drift.

noted_drifts: English vendor/education sources shift from sovereign AI and national infrastructure toward enterprise product framing.
Counter/critique source is still weak; GraphRAG comparison is not a true failure-case critique.
drift_gate.next_needed: add one genuine counter/failure source OR mark current mini-space as pro-ontology tilted.

layer_density_judgment.overall: usable for layer-reading practice; not balanced enough for authority/promotion
